meta.title: Cookie Policy — Synthnode
meta.description: What cookies synthnode.dev uses, what they are for and how to manage them.

intro.heading: What are cookies?
intro.body: Cookies are small text files that websites store in your browser to save preferences and analyze usage.

ownCookies.heading: Own cookies
ownCookies.body: We only use localStorage to save your cookie consent preference. It is not sent to the server.

thirdPartyCookies.heading: Third-party cookies
items: Google AdSense: personalized advertising based on your browsing.

consent.heading: Your consent
consent.body: By accepting, you enable GA and AdSense. By rejecting, both services are blocked; the site remains fully functional.

howToDisable.heading: How to manage cookies
howToDisable.body: You can modify your consent at any time using the cookie settings button (bottom right corner) or from your browser settings.

contact.heading: Contact
contact.body: For questions about cookies, use the site's contact form.
